passages.quote: حرف جزم لنفي المضارع وقلبه ماضيا نحو {لم يلد ولم يولد}
passages.interpretation: The initial لم marker supports a negated clause category; this does not parse its opaque predicate, assert its truth, or transfer its scope to a later clause.

passages.quote: إحداهما واو الاستئناف نحو {لنبين لكم ونقر في الأرحام ما نشاء}
passages.interpretation: Resumptive waw is documented. The exact semicolon and spacing grammar is editorial, and this passage does not license every waw as resumptive.

passages.quote: وهذا متعين للاستئناف لأن العطف يجعله شريكا في النفي فيلزم التناقض
passages.interpretation: A source example distinguishes conjunction sharing negation from resumption; the implementation is a bounded text envelope, not a universal scope inference.

passages.quote: قصدت به البلد والموضع ذكرته وصرفته
passages.interpretation: Retained lexical evidence for قصدت به. The first-person explicit-cue reading in this adapter remains an editorial interpretation, not a proof of speaker intent.

limitations: Only exact operators, the explicit semicolon boundary and preserved opaque bodies are checked.
The denied clause is not parsed as an event, and its truth is not asserted.
The later clause diagnostic does not become a proof of intention, external reference or whole-Arabic completeness.
Unvocalized/mixed operator envelopes are separate source-structural records; no missing vowels are invented.
No alias الحيوان المعروف is installed or inferred; a dictionary gloss does not resolve a new-context definite reference.
Neither source passage asserts that modern punctuation alone determines every Arabic scope.
